name: IO-86
note: FM repeater in a near-equatorial orbit, so it is only reachable from low latitudes.
amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: LAPAN, Indonesia’s space agency, with ORARI, Indonesia’s amateur radio society
profile.story: LAPAN-A2 flies in a near-equatorial orbit, so it only passes over places in or near the tropics. Where it does reach, it offers an FM repeater, an APRS digipeater and occasional pictures.
